```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
################################################################################
# load custom functions
source('helper_functions.R', local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r load_data}
# load raw aoa data
raw_aoa <- read_csv("../data/raw/item_based_data.csv")

# keep only the relevant demographics columns
participants_metadata <- raw_aoa |>
  select(ID, list, gender, age, country, education, L1, monoling, sight, children, child_age) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# save csv
write_excel_csv(participants_metadata, "../data/demographic_overview/participants_metadata.csv")
```
